{{Quote|I've been trying to raise the ''Millennium Falcon'' ever since your first order, but I've gotten no response! It's like&mdash;they've simply dropped out of ''existence!''|Parton, to Leia Organa|<ref name="marvel58" />}}
'''Parton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Yeoman/Legends|yeoman]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Yeoman Parton was present when the Alliance conducted an ambitious experiment to conceal its [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] within the chromosphere of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Arbran]] by way of a protective field created by five [[Kerts-Bhrg field generator]]s. After the experiment began, Parton accompanied Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] back to [[Haven Base]] on the nearby planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] aboard a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Per Organa's orders, Parton attempted to send a comm message to the Rebel [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to recall her trusted friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to assist when an accident left the crew of the main Kerts-Bhrg generator unconscious. Skywalker could not be reached, but disaster was nonetheless averted.<ref name="marvel58" />

==Behind the scenes==
Parton appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' 58]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]] and released in [[1982]]. While the character is only referred to as "Yeoman" in dialogue, her name can be seen on a tag on the front of her uniform.<ref name="marvel58" />
